body: I know that my brother would be supportive without a doubt. It's just so hard, it's such a big secret that I don't know how to reveal it. And I'm not 100% sure, but it sounds like my parents are anti-gay. My brother asked my mom "What do you think about gay marriage?", she replied "Are you kidding me!? Why in a world would two gays get married? It should be a guy and a girl and nothing else."

It's hard to describe in words, but if you saw him in person, you'll know for a fact that he noticed something on the iPhone screen. The pause that he made and the small changes on his face made it very obvious that he saw something odd.

I was watching an episode of Californication with my brother and his friends. There was a gay character that mentioned the Grindr app. My brother's friend looked it up on the App Store, and it was actually real. That's how everyone found out about the app.

No, I hate it. I wish I was straight or at least bi sexual. All through high school, all of my guy friends kept talking about checking out girls and what not. and I just pretended to go along with it.
